headline: Sensex and Nifty snap winning streak as inflation concerns drag market lower

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on investor sentiment during the trading session
Heavyweight stocks including HDFC Bank, Titan Company, and Shriram Finance saw selling pressure
Indices snapped their previous rally despite firm early global cues and earlier foreign inflows
Nifty fell below the key 25,150 level as market indices ended lower across the board
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 300 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,144
Shriram Finance was among the top losers, while Manappuram Finance dropped 4%
YES Bank sought a Supreme Court review regarding an ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-down ruling
Oil India declared it is on track to achieve 4 MMT crude oil production this fiscal year
summary: Indian market indices snapped their winning streak on November 13 as Sensex fell over 300 points and Nifty closed below 25,150 due to inflation concerns. Financial and retail stocks like Shriram Finance, Manappuram Finance, HDFC Bank, and Titan led the decline. In stock-specific developments, TVS Motor announced a key leadership elevation and Oil India reiterated its crude production target.
